shape: nobody talks about a small, true feeling everyone has had

slides.text: nobody talks about how she still cuts your sandwich into triangles, then [[eats the crusts standing over the sink]].

caption:
she spent twenty years pretending she liked the ends of the bread.
some things only make sense when you start making your own lunch.
send this to your mum next time she asks if you've eaten.

#mother #mumquotes #motherdaughter #motherson
alt: a small green donkey wearing a beige cardigan holds a warm mug with both hooves as text reads about a mother cutting sandwiches into triangles and eating the crusts over the sink
